related.description: Lightweight service virtualization/ API simulation / API mocking tool for developers and testers
Record your test suite's HTTP interactions and replay them during future test runs for fast, deterministic, accurate tests.
In-page HTTP controller for frontend development. Intercept, modify, and simulate API responses directly in the browser.
Automatically mock your HTTP interactions to simplify and speed up testing
High-performance, multi-protocol mock server. HTTP, WebSocket, gRPC, MQTT, SSE, GraphQL, SOAP in one binary.
